content.text: prolactinoma: cabergoline = tx of choice (better tolerated & more potent than bromocriptine); stop @ (+) preg test if trying to conceive; acromegaly: cabergoline = typically used in mild dz
↑doses (esp cabergoline) thought to have caused valvular ♡ dz in PD; consider echo surveillance, esp > 3 mg/wk; may cause ↑impulsivity & occasionally psychosis
Start 0.25 mg PO twice wkly. Titrate by ↑ 0.25 mg twice wkly @ intervals of ⍉ < 4 wks to achieve norm serum PRL. Max 1 mg twice wkly

CI: uncontrolled HTN - known hypersensitivity to ergot derivatives. CI: Hx of ♡ valvular dx (valvulopathy of any valve shown on pre-tx eval, incl echocardiography) or pericardial fibrosis - Hx of pleural · pulm or retroperitoneal fibrotic dz. B4 initiating, evaluate for valvular Hdz, incl w an echocardiogram - if valvular dz detected, ⍉ administer. Monitor for valvulopathy w ♡ echocardiogram @ intervals of 6 to 12 mo or as clinically indicated. If pleural · pericardial · retroperitoneal or pulm fibrosis occur, d/c. Check BP @ baseline & during tx & monitor for orthostatic hypotension - warn pts about the risk & precautions when rising from a supine or sitting position. Specifically ask pts about new or ↑gambling urges · sexual urges · uncontrolled spending or other urges - consider dose reduction or stopping if such urges develop. ⍉ use for inhibition or suppression of postpartum physio lactation (risk of serious adverse rxns). ⍉recommended w D2-antagonists such as phenothiazines · butyrophenones · thioxanthenes or metoclopramide. Severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh C) ⍉recommended - in mod HI (Child-Pugh B) ↑ monitoring of cabergoline-assoc adverse rxns. OD: take measures to support BP if necessary
